decisions.reason: Height-adjustable desks build on existing desk and mechanism knowledge, allowing the firm to assimilate ergonomic feedback and improve the product.
Chairs are core to a furniture maker, so related knowledge supports learning from early sales and refining the family.
Floor cushions from carpets represent an accessory outside the firm's established furniture and upholstery knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve.
Upholstered sofas are closely related to the firm's existing soft furniture expertise, so even limited early visibility can be improved through accumulated knowledge.
High standing tables leverage existing table production capabilities and market knowledge.
A rug collection is distant from the firm's core furniture manufacturing knowledge, making it hard to assimilate feedback and compete effectively.
